answer: Audit a random fraction s of answers deeply, and scale the penalty by 1/s. A rotating non-kin jury re-grades only a sampled sliver, so audit cost stays low, yet any identity caught faking forfeits about 1/s times its gain — expected penalty is detection-rate times forfeit, s·(1/s)=1, tuned to exceed the most cheating could earn. A farm cannot know which submission the beacon draws for the walnut-hard deep review; the glacier samples slowly but crushes what it catches. More fakes mean more draws, so expected loss climbs with headcount while honest work never fails a check and pays nothing.
